label: Conversation
description: A conversation, such as a chat with a person or an assistant. Its messages are the rows of its messages table.

messages.description: The messages of the conversation, in the order they were appended.

author.description: Who wrote the message, such as a name, a handle or `assistant`.

text.description: What the message says. A message may have no text and only an attachment.

attachment.description: A picture or other file the message carries.
